full_judgment: 8. In this. case, he submits showing the schedule of the property that the property has not been specified with description sufficient to identify on which the plaintiff prayed for injunction out of total land of the plot and in support of his submission he cited a case reported in 42 DLR .(HCD) 434. He then submits that the trial court dismissed this suit for want of proof o cause of action for the injunction but the appellate court without reverting the said findings reversed the finding of the trial court, for which the impugned judgment and decree is not a proper judgment of reversal. He lastly submits that the learned appellate court without any independent assessment of evidence, and without reversing the reasoning’s of the trial court regarding possession of the defendants, and want of cause of action for the suit, has passed the impugned judgment and he referred to a case reported in 57 DLR (AD) 112, 6 BLC (AD) 130, 7 MLR (AD) 7, 51 DLR (AD) 81.
